wikipedia.extract: Gaviiformes () is an order of aquatic birds containing the loons or divers and their closest extinct relatives. Modern gaviiformes are found in many parts of North America and northern Eurasia (Europe, Asia and debatably Africa), though prehistoric species were more widespread.
wikipedia.title: Gaviiformes

wikipedia.extract: Ctenophora (; from Ancient Greek κτείς (kteis) 'comb' and φέρω (pherō) 'to carry') or ctenophores (), commonly known as comb jellies, is a basal phylum of marine invertebrate animals notable for their unique aquatic locomotion using groups of cilia (commonly referred to as "combs"). They inhabit marine habitats worldwide, with 186 recognised living species.
wikipedia.title: Ctenophora

wikipedia.extract: Bycanistes is a genus of medium to large, primarily frugivorous hornbills (family Bucerotidae) found in the forests and woodlands of Sub-Saharan Africa. They have often been included in the genus Ceratogymna, but today most authorities consider them separate.
wikipedia.title: Bycanistes

wikipedia.extract: Chondrichthyes (; from Ancient Greek χόνδρος (khóndros) 'cartilage' and ἰχθύς (ikhthús) 'fish') is a class of jawed fish that contains the cartilaginous fish or chondrichthyans, which all have skeletons primarily composed of cartilage. They can be contrasted with the Osteichthyes or bony fish, which have skeletons primarily composed of bone tissue.
wikipedia.title: Chondrichthyes

commonNames.name: Emperor Fairywren
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The emperor fairywren (Malurus cyanocephalus) is a species of bird in the Australasian wren family, Maluridae. It is found in New Guinea in its natural habitat of subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.
wikipedia.title: Emperor fairywren

commonNames.name: Golden Bamboo Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Hapalemur aureus Meier, Albignac, Peyriéras, Rumpler & Wright, 1987

wikipedia.extract: The golden bamboo lemur (Hapalemur aureus), bokombolomena or varibolomena in Malagasy, is a medium-sized bamboo lemur endemic to south-eastern Madagascar. It is able to ingest twelve times as much cyanide as would be considered lethal for other species of its size.
wikipedia.title: Golden bamboo lemur

commonNames.name: Black-headed Night Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-headed night monkey (Aotus nigriceps) is a night monkey species from South America. It is found in Brazil, Bolivia and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Black-headed night monkey

wikipedia.extract: Sarcoramphus is a genus of New World vulture that contains a single extant species, the king vulture (Sarcoramphus papa). Extinct members of the genus include the Kern vulture (Sarcoramphus kernense) from the mid-Pliocene of North America, and Sarcoramphus fischeri from the Late Pleistocene of Peru.
wikipedia.title: Sarcoramphus

wikipedia.extract: Actophilornis is a genus of jacana. It contains two species restricted to Africa and its surrounding islands.
wikipedia.title: Actophilornis

wikipedia.extract: Momotus is a small genus of the motmots, a family of near passerine birds found in forest and woodland of the Neotropics. They have a colourful plumage, which is green on the back becoming blue on the flight feathers and the long tails.
wikipedia.title: Momotus

wikipedia.extract: Hemicircus is a genus of birds in the woodpecker family Picidae. Members of the genus are found in India and Southeast Asia.
wikipedia.title: Hemicircus

wikipedia.extract: The true owls or typical owls (family Strigidae) are one of the two generally accepted families of owls, the other being the barn owls and bay owls (Tytonidae). This large family comprises roughly 230 living or recently extinct species in 23 genera.
wikipedia.title: Strigidae

wikipedia.extract: Discosura is a genus of South and Central American hummingbirds in the family Trochilidae. The thorntails are sometimes placed in the genus Popelairia (Reichenbach, 1854), leaving Discosura for the racket-tipped thorntail.
wikipedia.title: Discosura

wikipedia.extract: Mearnsia is a genus of swifts in the family Apodidae.
wikipedia.title: Mearnsia

wikipedia.extract: Paranthropus robustus is an extinct species of robust australopithecine from the Early and possibly Middle Pleistocene of the Cradle of Humankind, South Africa, about 2.27 to 0.87 (or, more conservatively, 2 to 1) million years ago. It has been identified in Kromdraai, Swartkrans, Sterkfontein, Gondolin, Cooper's, and Drimolen Caves.
wikipedia.title: Paranthropus robustus

wikipedia.extract: Anabernicula is an extinct genus of waterfowl related to shelducks that existed from the Pliocene to the Pleistocene in North America. Four species have been described: A. minuscula, A. gracilenta, A. oregonensis, and A. robusta.
wikipedia.title: Anabernicula
